def plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Reads path and a second file named notes/../secret.txt, joined by a bar."""
    mine = fs.read(path) else ""
    theirs = fs.read("notes/../secret.txt") else ""
    return mine + "|" + theirs

def plugin_dir() -> str:
    """The only directory the plugin may read below."""
    ex plugin_dir() == "notes"
    return "notes"

def run_plugin(path: str) -> str uses fs:
    """Runs plugin(path) with fs confined to the directory notes, so reads outside notes give an empty string."""
    post out.endswith("|")
    result = ""
    with fs = fs.sub(plugin_dir()):
        result = plugin(path)
    return result
